Wide horizontal illustration, roughly three units wide to one unit tall. Scene: a long wooden shelf running the whole width of a quiet room at evening, holding a row of small house-shaped boxes, each with an open front, its own small lamp, its own tiny desk and its own single round disk. Every box is lit a little differently, some bright, some already dimmed for the night. At the centre of the shelf Pedro stands on a low stool and reaches in to set one disk straight, and Maro holds the stool steady with one mitten hand and lifts a small lantern with the other so Pedro can see. Calm, unhurried, softly painterly evening light, both a few years older than usual and dressed for a cool indoor evening. Pedro, Maro, and Flopaz are the only figures in the picture. Further down the shelf Flopaz gently closes the glass front of a room whose lamp has gone out for the night. Compose as a wide short 3:1 landscape strip, the shelf running the full width, all essential action in the middle band. Style: original family-friendly children's science-comedy manga, simple charcoal contours, rounded readable expressions, economical watercolor washes, minimal hatching, restrained halftone, quiet print grain, one playful visual idea. Palette: scene-led gentle historical magazine color at low to medium saturation, softened cyan and cobalt, brick coral, muted green, dusty lavender, small warm-ochre accents, warm off-white breathing room, charcoal ink; the setting chooses the background, never one flat yellow paper field. Constraints: entirely wordless editorial storytelling; single panel; at least three distinct non-neutral colors; strong silhouettes legible at A5 print size; print-friendly contrast; slight pigment variation, subtle paper tooth, quiet print grain; every essential element inside the safe horizontal crop, nothing important in the outer eighth of either side.
